title: Dark Souls' notes from strangers were inspired by a car stuck in the snow.

instagram.caption:
Dark Souls' notes from strangers were inspired by a car stuck in the snow.

In Dark Souls, players can leave short glowing notes on the floor for people they will never meet: warnings like "Beware of ambush ahead", hints about hidden paths, and plenty of jokes.

Director Hidetaka Miyazaki got the idea on a snowy hill. Strangers got out and pushed the stuck cars up, his included, then drove off before he could thank them.
